title: Airtable list records with a long filterByFormula fails once the URL passes 16,000 characters
symptoms: Lookup by a list of IDs fails only when the list is long
Request rejected for an OR() formula over a few hundred record IDs
Same formula works in a POST to listRecords
cause: Airtable rejects request URLs of 16,000 characters or more, and an encoded filterByFormula grows fast. The GET form of list records puts the formula in the query string.
fix: Send long queries as POST to the listRecords path with the parameters in the JSON body, or split the ID list into smaller groups.
affected: Airtable Web API list records, as of 2026-10
